reason: I'd happily play with the free tricks and show my nephews, but I don't pay for apps, and 99 ₪ for something I'd use at a few family dinners feels like a lot when there are free magic apps already.
objection: There are free magic apps that do the same, and paying by card on some website for an app that isn't even in the App Store makes me a bit suspicious.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks absolutely blew the kids away and the full version was a one-time 20-30 ₪, I might break my rule once.
